Status: in_progress, untouched in this session by the coordinator's instruction. No edits, ticks or plan review were run on it.

- Per the coordinator, the last criterion now waits for the first SCHEDULED Live External Integration run after 3336 (or the fallback) lands. That run is due Mondays 06:00 UTC; the next is 2026-11-15 22:00 PST. Record it read-only, without dispatching. The criteria must not be changed to fit the evidence.
- Next: after that scheduled run, record the run id, per-job conclusions and timestamp. If it concludes success, tick the boxes with provenance lines, re-run review-plan only if the description changed, then close with class preexisting. Never --force.
